summary: Master data management and processing with our comprehensive CSPro Desktop Course. Gain practical skills to optimize your data handling techniques.
lede: CSPro Desktop data processing covers structured data-entry design, validation, cleaning, and export for survey and census records. For data managers, survey programmers, statisticians, and others preparing structured datasets, the course covers building dictionaries and forms, applying edit checks, and managing household and person-level records. It also addresses automated cleaning and quality checks, correction logs, and exports to SPSS, Stata, or Microsoft Excel for analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who work with structured data entry, quality control, and data preparation in CSPro Desktop environments.
modules: Data Entry Forms and Edit Rules
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with structured data collection, survey or census workflows, and basic file management. Prior experience using CSPro Desktop is helpful, but not required if you already understand data dictionaries, variable coding, and questionnaire structure. No programming background is required, although you should be comfortable learning simple CSPro logic statements and using desktop software on your own laptop. The course is taught at an operational application level for CSPro workflow design and validation, with conceptual awareness of Dataverse integration and broader data-sharing practices.
